text:
Maya: Quick sync — pricing/packaging impl dependencies. Need to confirm owners and sequence: metering changes -> billing adapter -> quota enforcement -> contract validation. Who's ok to own contract validation?

Sam: I can own the billing adapter + PR. Question for @Liz — how will metering surface consumption keys (name/shape)?

Liz: Metering PR is basically ready on branch `liz/metering/packaging-2026`. We will emit `consumption_key` and `usage_bucket` once quota schema v2 lands. Need schema owners to sign off.

Chris: Billing (Chris) here — I need the stable `consumption_key` name and currency mapping. Also: will metering backfill last 30d? Backfill changes invoice calculations.

Devon: Legal — contract constraints need to be explicit in the contract model (we'd like `contract_version` and `constraint_set`). If semantics change, we need a migration/consent plan. Propose `contract_constraint_v2` flag. @Maya can we lock on this before canary?

infra-bot: CI failed on `liz/metering/packaging-2026` — Tests: `TestUsageBucket` failed. See https://ci.redwood-inference/build/9842

Sam: noted. @Liz can you rebase and run tests? I'll queue a quick review afterwards and add billing codeowner review.

Liz: rebased & pushed a fix at 2917659000, tests pass locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/5123

Sam: grabbing that PR now. If CI looks good I'll start wiring the billing adapter to `consumption_key` and map currency. ETA: EOD Thu for initial adapter spike.

Maya: Milestone: canary target 2026-04-03. Tentative owners: metering = Liz, billing = Sam, quotas = TBD, contracts = Devon. @Chris confirm invoice impacts & whether we need a feature flag for packaged pricing.

Chris: Confirm invoice schema change required. We should gate packaged-plan pricing behind a feature flag to avoid immediate invoice shifts. Filing BLG-256 to track.

Maya: OK. Action items: 1) Liz: finalize metering PR + schema ticket. 2) Sam: billing adapter spike + PR. 3) Quotas owner: please nominate. 4) Devon: contract versioning note. Drop blockers by EOD.

Liz: Blocker: none after the fix. :thumbsup:

Sam: Blocker: still need example events for promo-code edge cases (anonymized). Can someone paste a sample event?

Chris: Sample event (anonymized):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_XXX",
  "plan": "packaged_pro",
  "usage": {"tokens": 12450, "storage_gb": 0.12},
  "promo_code": "NEWYEAR50",
  "consumption_key": "pkg_pro_cust_XXX_202603",
  "currency": "USD"
}
```

Devon: Legal ok with versioning approach, but we need a short customer-facing note for contract changes + an internal migration doc. I'll coordinate with docs and add to legal backlog.

Maya: Thanks. Final ask: everyone drop 1-line blocker status here by EOD and add any missing owners. I'll escalate if we need extra infra or SRE time. We'll follow up with a short RFC in product-notes and schedule a 15m sync if any blockers remain.

Sam: Blocker status: waiting on final event samples for promo-edge cases (from Chris) — otherwise unblocked for initial spike.

Chris: Blocker status: need feature flag gating + confirmation on backfill window. Filing BLG-256.

Liz: Blocker status: none after CI fix. PR link above.

Devon: Blocker status: will need docs note; no legal hold.

Maya: Great — I'll capture owners + actions and ping again tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
